title: Maintaining the Corpus Luteum
text: Normally, the corpus luteum degenerates after about 14 days if pregnancy does not occur. For pregnancy to continue, something must signal the corpus luteum to keep producing progesterone.

title: The Pregnancy Signal
text: The embryo produces Human Chorionic Gonadotropin (HCG). 'Chorionic' refers to the chorion (part of the placenta). 'Gonadotropin' means it affects the gonads. HCG keeps the corpus luteum functioning.
